attack: Honest transfer with live consent (control)
outcome: delivered

attack: Request with no consent on the ledger
outcome: TransferError: no active consent on ledger

attack: Request after the patient revoked consent
outcome: TransferError: no active consent on ledger

attack: Request outside the consented scope
outcome: TransferError: no active consent on ledger

attack: Request after the consent expired
outcome: TransferError: no active consent on ledger

attack: Sender cut off from the consortium misses an anchored revocation
outcome: TransferError: stale replica: behind the public anchor

attack: Same partition, sender's freshness check switched off
outcome: TransferError: key mismatch: session keys differ

attack: Consent re-scoped in a block not yet anchored; receiver lags one block
outcome: TransferError: key mismatch: session keys differ

attack: Man-in-the-middle swaps the sender's ephemeral key
outcome: TransferError: sender signature invalid

attack: Request signed by an unregistered identity
outcome: TransferError: requester not registered or bad signature

attack: Wrapped data key replayed into a new session
outcome: TransferError: key mismatch: session keys differ

attack: One bit flipped in a stored ciphertext chunk
outcome: TransferError: ciphertext does not match on-chain CID

attack: Chunks of a multi-chunk record reordered
outcome: TransferError: ciphertext does not match on-chain CID

attack: Transaction with a forged signature
outcome: LedgerError: bad signature

attack: Committed transaction submitted a second time
outcome: LedgerError: replayed transaction

attack: Provider tries to grant consent on the patient's behalf
outcome: LedgerError: only the patient changes consent

attack: Colluding quorum rewrites an ANCHORED block to erase a revocation
outcome: quorum signatures valid, public proof rejected

attack: Control: the same rewrite on a block that is NOT yet anchored
outcome: quorum signatures valid, no public evidence yet (exposure window)

attack: Patient proves a revocation against the anchored consent root
outcome: revoked entry proven, live entry rejected

attack: Dual-ledger proof presented for a transaction that was never committed
outcome: proof rejected

attack: Break-glass access by a clinician without the emergency role
outcome: LedgerError: not an emergency-authorised clinician
